Meta.title: Tesla Explorer
Meta.description: Evening drive planner for Tesla owners in the USA: routes that fit charge and time, 3D map, clips about stops.

Home.headline: Where to go tonight while the battery still has miles
Home.pitch: Type what you want — dinner, kids by the water, a quiet loop. You get a route that fits free hours and charge, watch the drive on a 3D map before you leave, and open a short clip about each stop.
Home.proof: Fits charge & time · 3D map · clips about stops
Home.heroPromptExample: Chinese food and a walk with the kids near water
Home.howIntro: One chat — and you already see where you're going.
Home.step1Body: Free hours and charge sit next to the chat. A line like “Chinese food and a walk with the kids near water” is enough.
Home.step2Body: Stops, miles, a charger if you need one. Off? Edit or decline.
Home.step3Title: Play the drive on the map
Home.step3Body: The car runs the line in 3D. Scrub, pause, open a place clip at cafes and parks.
Home.demoChatUser: Chinese food and a walk with the kids near water
Home.demoChatAssistant: Dinner nearby, then a short lakeside walk. Opening the map…
Home.demoChatPlaceholder: e.g. dinner and a calm loop
Home.benefit1Body: Instead of hunting cafes, parks, and reviews one by one — one request and a ready loop.
Home.benefit2Body: Plans respect your Tesla model and battery %. Short on miles? A charger lands in the chain.
Home.benefit3Body: The 3D map shows where the line goes. At stops you can open a short clip about the place before you leave.
Home.finalTitle: Tesla in the US and a free evening?
Home.finalPitch: Sign in with Google and sketch the next drive in a couple of minutes.

Onboarding.title: Create your profile
Onboarding.intro: Save your home and work addresses, who rides with you, kids, and which Tesla you drive. Battery is asked when you plan a trip.
Onboarding.introEdit: Update home, work, household, or Tesla model — the co-pilot uses these on every plan.
Onboarding.addressSearchUnavailable: Address search needs a Mapbox token — you can still type the full address.

Onboarding.interestsPlaceholder: Food you like, places you enjoy, things to avoid
Onboarding.errorGeneric: Check the form and try again.

Onboarding.errorUnauthorized: Sign in again to save your profile.

Auth.signInIntro: Continue with Google to save your profile and routes.

Dashboard.title: Plan a drive
Dashboard.intro: This is your cabinet. Chat with your AI co-pilot — it already knows your car, home, and crew.
Dashboard.assistantCue: Type what you want from the drive — this is a conversation with an AI route agent, not a blank form. When the plan is ready, open the 3D map.
Dashboard.copilotSubtitle: AI assistant · already knows your Tesla, home, and work
Dashboard.tripSettingsHint: Defaults for this chat — change anytime before you send.
Dashboard.addressSearchUnavailable: Address search needs a Mapbox token — type the full address.
